publicDashboard.title: Game Servers
publicDashboard.howToConnectIntro: These servers live on a private network, so you need to join it once before you can play. It only takes a couple of minutes — after that, joining is just copy and paste.
publicDashboard.connectStep1: Download and install NetBird using the link below, then sign in with the login your admin gave you.
publicDashboard.connectStep1Tip: Heads up: NetBird sets itself to start automatically with Windows. We recommend turning that off — right-click its icon in the system tray, open Settings, and disable "Launch on start-up" (or similar). You'll turn it on yourself whenever you want to play, as explained next.
publicDashboard.connectStep2Title: Turn it on to play, off when you're done
publicDashboard.connectStep2: Before playing, open NetBird and wait until it shows Connected — the addresses below only work while it's running. When you're finished playing, turn NetBird off (or quit it); you don't need to stay connected all the time.
publicDashboard.connectStep3: Come back to this page. Each server card shows a Connect address, like 100.64.0.3:27015. Click the small copy icon next to it.
publicDashboard.connectStep4: Open the game, look for "Direct Connect" or "Join by IP" in its menu, paste the address there, and play.
publicDashboard.legendOnline: Green dot — server is online, ready to join now.
publicDashboard.legendStarting: Yellow dot — server is starting or stopping, give it a moment.
publicDashboard.legendOffline: Red dot — server is offline, nobody can join yet.

settings.title: Settings
settings.serverHostDesc: The host address shown to visitors on the public dashboard as the connection target for all game servers.
settings.serverHostHint: IP or hostname visible to visitors
settings.serverHostNote: Leave blank to fall back to SERVER_HOST in .env. When NetBird is active, the VPN IP always takes priority over this field.
settings.registrationDesc: Controls whether new visitors can register a display name. Disable once all your friends have joined to prevent unknown visitors from self-registering.
settings.registrationClosedWarning: Registration is closed. Existing visitors can still connect; new names cannot be added until you re-enable this.
settings.dataStorageDesc: Global path on the host machine where all game server data volumes are stored. Each game gets its own subfolder inside this root.
settings.effectiveDesc: Game data will be stored at:
settings.migrationWarning: Changing this path will not automatically move existing game data. You must stop each server and manually copy its data folder before switching.
settings.dangerZoneDesc: Destructive actions that affect all game servers at once. These cannot be undone.
settings.wipeAllDesc: Stops and removes all containers, then permanently deletes all game data folders.
settings.wipeConfirmMessage: This will stop every running container, remove all containers, and permanently delete all game data. This cannot be undone.
settings.notificationsDesc: Get alerted when a server crashes unexpectedly.
settings.discordDesc: Post a message to a Discord channel when a server crashes.
settings.discordHint: Paste a Discord channel webhook URL
settings.pushDesc: Native OS notification delivered to this device when a server crashes, even with the tab closed.
settings.pushNotSupported: Push notifications are not supported in this browser
settings.pushPermissionDenied: Notification permission denied — enable it in browser settings
